visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young men are seated outdoors on a grey stone ledge at night. The man on the left wears a light grey long-sleeved sweatshirt and looks down at a smartphone while holding a white cup. The man on the right, in a dark green t-shirt with a black backpack, waves enthusiastically at the camera with a wide, joyful expression. The background features a brightly lit urban commercial area with tall pillars and modern architecture. A colorful 'HahaTai' logo is positioned in the top right corner. (2) The camera moves closer to the man on the right as he speaks animatedly, his hands gesturing frequently. A person holding a microphone with a 'HahaTai' sign enters from the right, partially visible. Bright yellow and blue text overlays appear at the bottom and center, emphasizing his words. (3) The shot cuts to a close-up of the man on the left holding a smartphone, displaying a music app interface with a list of songs and album art. He smiles broadly and interacts with the interviewer. Lighting remains consistent, coming from warm overhead street lamps and neon signs from nearby shops. (4) Both men engage in a dynamic conversation, laughing and leaning toward each other. The man on the left briefly hugs the man on the right. Rapid editing cuts between their reactions and specific song listings shown on the phone screen. Variety-show style graphics and text bubbles float around them to mark emotional peaks. (5) The man in the dark green shirt looks directly at the camera while discussing music awards, holding a sign in his hand. He briefly covers his face in embarrassment and laughs after a verbal slip-up. The urban background shows blurred figures of passers-by and city lights. (6) The video concludes with both men laughing together as they respond to a final question. The camera stays at eye level, maintaining a friendly and conversational perspective throughout the interview process.
